howdy, it’s Barsee again.

happy monday, AI family, and welcome back to AI Valley.

**here are the biggest things worth knowing today:**

* OpenAI's next model solved decades-old math problems

* Alibaba launches its most powerful AI model yet

* Google gives humanoid robots full-body AI control

* Meta plans to spend up to $145B on AI infrastructure

* Plus trending AI tools, posts, and resources

Let’s _dive_ into the Valley of AI…


----------

----------
#### **WISPR FLOW**

## [Everywhere workflow (one voice layer across tools)](https://ref.wisprflow.ai/aivalley)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/f1e51523-6e5e-408a-b75b-97e8d8cbac67/Newsletters_Image_1920x1080__7___7_.png?t=1785766156)

Flow is a voice layer that works anywhere you type. Use it to respond in Slack, write docs, craft emails, or prompt an AI assistant without switching tools or copy/pasting. It's the fastest way to get high-quality text into your workflow, whether you're drafting, editing, or ideating.

[Try for free](https://ref.wisprflow.ai/aivalley)

~_*This is sponsored_~


----------

----------
#### **THROUGH THE VALLEY**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/72178c36-8182-474d-a723-819df8018189/geminirobotics2-featured__1_.png?t=1785768037)
Caption: Courtesy: Google DeepMind

**1/ OpenAI's next model solved decades-old math problems:** OpenAI revealed that [Astra](https://x.com/polynoamial/status/2083467194663571701?s=20), an internal version of its next major model family, [solved](https://openai.com/index/ten-advances-in-mathematics) 10 long open problems across mathematics and computer science, including some that had remained unsolved for nearly 30 years. The proofs were formally verified in Lean and cost roughly $2,000 in API tokens to generate, and reports suggest Astra could launch as GPT-5.7, GPT-6, or under a new brand with more advanced versions released under restricted access.

**2/ Alibaba launches its most powerful AI model yet:** Alibaba unveiled [Qwen3.8-Max](https://x.com/Alibaba_Qwen/status/2084100707423289643?s=20), a 2.4 trillion parameter multimodal model built for coding, research, long-horizon agent tasks, and visual reasoning. The model supports a 1 million token context window, reportedly performs on par with Anthropic's Fable 5 in several benchmarks, and is designed to handle complex workloads with minimal human input. DeepSeek also released V4-Flash, an ultra-low-cost model estimated to be more than 100 times cheaper to run than Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.

**3/ Google gives humanoid robots full-body AI control:** Google DeepMind introduced [Gemini Robotics 2](https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robotics-2-brings-whole-body-intelligence-to-robots), a new AI model that controls an entire humanoid robot instead of just its arms, enabling coordinated movements like walking, crouching, reaching, and handling objects. The system can also plan complex tasks, coordinate multiple robots, run locally without constant internet access, and includes new safety features, though it remains a research project with no public release date. ([watch the demo here](https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robotics-2-brings-whole-body-intelligence-to-robots))

**4/ Meta plans to spend up to $145B on AI infrastructure:** Mark Zuckerberg says Meta will spend up to [$145 billion](https://siliconangle.com/2026/07/28/meta-build-14b-el-paso-data-center-campus-blackrock) on AI infrastructure in 2026, including a new 1-gigawatt Texas data center, as the company races to build an agent-first internet. Meta plans to bring persistent AI assistants to WhatsApp and Messenger, while also expanding enterprise AI tools and updating its smart glasses with new privacy protections.


----------

----------
# TRENDING TOOLS


--------------------
* [Fish Audio](https://x.com/FishAudio/status/2082152596739862853?s=20) > Clone any voice from just 5 seconds of audio. Delivers highly expressive speech with word level control over emotion, intonation, and pacing at roughly one sixth the cost of ElevenLabs

* [AI YC Interview with Gstack Agents](https://gstack-meeting.com/) > AI interview specialists join your Google Meet, conduct YC style mock interviews, and give real time feedback on your answers

* [Coast](https://coast.app/) > A fully local memory layer for you and your AI agents, built from everything you see and do on your Mac

* [HeyGen Video Podcast](https://app.heygen.com/apps/video-podcast) > Turn a document, link, or idea into a fully produced two host video podcast with scenes, camera cuts, and B-roll

* [Claude Overlay](https://github.com/shengyanlin/claude-overlay) > It provides a floating desktop window that reads your screen and runs Claude Code tasks directly

* [Superlinear](https://superlinear.fm/) > Learn four practical agent engineering habits through a free video course and podcast series

* [Motion in Claude](https://x.com/motion_so/status/2083992227114520576?s=20) > Paste a product URL and Claude creates a complete launch video with a script, voiceover, editing, and final render

* [Dreamina Seedance 2.5](https://x.com/BytePlusGlobal/status/2083069262969844158) > BytePlus has launched its new cinematic AI video model for generating high quality videos

* [Gemini Spark](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-spark-updates-july-2026/) > Google's personal AI agent now integrates directly with Chrome for in browser assistance

* [Qwen3.8-Max](https://www.qwencloud.com/models/qwen3.8-max) > Alibaba's latest flagship reasoning model can code autonomously for more than 10 days

If you’ve been following our coverage, you know that many people at Every—CEO Dan Shipper https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiV2hhdCBJZiBTbGFjayBXYXMgWW91ciBBSSBDb21tYW5kIENlbnRlciIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNjAsInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InBvc3QiLCJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL2V2ZXJ5LnRvL0BkYW5zaGlwcGVyIiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjZ9, head of growth Austin Tedesco https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiV2hhdCBJZiBTbGFjayBXYXMgWW91ciBBSSBDb21tYW5kIENlbnRlciIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNjAsInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InBvc3QiLCJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL2V2ZXJ5LnRvL0B0ZWRlc2NhdSIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjo3fQ==, and head of operations Arielle Shipper, to name a few—have reduced the mental fragmentation of bouncing between apps by working almost exclusively within Codex https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiV2hhdCBJZiBTbGFjayBXYXMgWW91ciBBSSBDb21tYW5kIENlbnRlciIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNjAsInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InBvc3QiLCJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL2V2ZXJ5LnRvL2NvbnRleHQtd2luZG93L2NvZGV4LWluLXByYWN0aWNlIiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjh9. It’s where they handle emails, write Slack messages, build new features, and draft articles using Codex’s in-app browser.

Senior applied AI engineer Nityesh Agarwal https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiV2hhdCBJZiBTbGFjayBXYXMgWW91ciBBSSBDb21tYW5kIENlbnRlciIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNjAsInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InBvc3QiLCJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL2V2ZXJ5LnRvL0BuaXR5ZXNoIiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjl9 is a fan of the general concept but thinks there’s a better, model-agnostic platform for AI-assisted work: Slack, which is optimized to make it easy to manage multiple tasks at once and reduce context-switching.

Here’s how he turned the platform into an agent-native operating system

Nityesh first created a personal Slack coding agent—named Luo Ji, after the protagonist in science fiction series The Three-Body Problem. Slack has long allowed developers to create bots and apps on its platform and connect them to outside servers. Using that infrastructure, Nityesh connected Luo Ji to Claude Code https://every. on a spare Macbook Air, which functions as a server.

Then he modified the connector script to meet his specifications, including a routing rule: Each top-level message in a Slack channel kicks off a new Claude Code session, while a reply in the resulting message thread resumes that same session. (He used the same general setup to build Claudie https://every., the consulting team’s AI project manager.)

https://every. long-running Slack thread between Nityesh and Luo Ji. (Screenshot courtesy of Nityesh Agarwal.)




With this in place, Slack becomes a full-blown project management tool. Nityesh keeps a channel for each project, and each conversation thread within that project channel is an individual task. When Luo Ji completes a task, it sends Nityesh a notification and marks the thread unread, letting him know that there’s completed work to review.

Since Slack allows file attachments, Luo Ji can post screenshots of what it built to make the review even easier. Nityesh can request a change, or mark the thread unread and come back to it later. The chat history remains attached to the task instead of getting buried in a long agent conversation or scattered across tabs, turning the platform into a project dashboard.

PULSE CHECK

GETTING THROWN BY OPUS 5

Toward the end of Every’s all-team standup on Monday, the conversation turned to Opus 5. More people from the team had tried it by then, and the same quirks kept coming up.

Head of operations Arielle Shipper found that Opus 5 needed too much management and repeated prompting to keep its responses simple—more than Fable or Opus 4.8. Cora https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiVGFtaW5nIE9wdXMgNSIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNTksInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InByb21vIiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9jb3JhLmNvbXB1dGVyIiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjd9 general manager Kieran Klaassen https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiVGFtaW5nIE9wdXMgNSIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNTksInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InByb21vIiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9Aa2llcmFuXzEzNTUiLCJwb3NpdGlvbiI6OH0= advanced a theory that the new Opus is intended to be a subagent to Fable, and communicates as though it were speaking to agents instead of humans.

CEO Dan Shipper https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiVGFtaW5nIE9wdXMgNSIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNTksInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InByb21vIiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9AZGFuc2hpcHBlciIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjoxMX0= and Spiral https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiVGFtaW5nIE9wdXMgNSIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNTksInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InByb21vIiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93cml0ZXRoZXNwaXJhbC5jb20iLCJwb3NpdGlvbiI6MTJ9 general manager Marcus Moretti https://every.to/emails/click/1eb47536f45a3508ca723b5b2cb780e942839f966e324ef3162cd49469aec49f/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiVGFtaW5nIE9wdXMgNSIsInBvc3RfaWQiOjQzNTksInBvc3RfdHlwZSI6InByb21vIiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9AbWFyY3VzX2ZkODMwMl8xIiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjEzfQ== had both handed Opus a substantial job with a clear finish line, then left it alone.
